For each Chemistry department with more than 10 reserved library materials for courses in the Engineering or Science schools and only for courses that have materials, list the department name, the total number of reserved library materials, the subject title, term code, offering department name, responsible faculty name, department full name, school name, the maximum number of enrolled students for each subject considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by subject offered key, and calculate the reserved materials per maximum enrolled students (rounded), ordering the results by reserved materials per maximum enrolled students in descending order.
sub_sqls: SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS total_reserved_materials FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm ON td.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) > 10

SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND t0.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'

WITH ReservedMaterials AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS total_reserved_materials FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm ON td.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) > 10 ), ChemistrySubjects AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND t0.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' ) SELECT rm.department_name, rm.total_reserved_materials, cs.SUBJECT_TITLE, cs.TERM_CODE, cs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cs.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, cs.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, cs.SCHOOL_NAME, cs.max_enrolled_students, ROUND(rm.total_reserved_materials / NULLIF(cs.max_enrolled_students, 0), 2) AS reserved_materials_per_max_enrollment FROM ReservedMaterials rm JOIN ChemistrySubjects cs ON rm.department_name = cs.join_dept_name ORDER BY reserved_materials_per_max_enrollment DESC

question: For each department, provide the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one associated course material, and for each department also include a grand total row for all departments in the format of (null, total average, total stddev). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, avg_enrolled_students, stddev_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(avg_enrolled_students) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(stddev_enrolled_students) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and find the average and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one associated course material, but only for the Chemistry department.
sub_sqls: SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For each department name and course level where the course is degree granting and the total units are greater than 6, and for each subject code in that degree-granting department, provide the department name, course level, number of unique courses, minimum total units offered, average total units for that department and course level, subject code, number of subject codes, minimum department budget code, and the full department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ), subq1 AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.course_count, ic.min_total_units, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte1 ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.course_count, ic.min_total_units ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE ), subq2 AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.subject_code_count, ic.min_dept_budget_code, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte2 ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.COURSE_LEVEL, s1.course_count, s1.min_total_units, s1.avg_total_units, s2.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.subject_code_count, s2.min_dept_budget_code, s2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department name and course level where the course is degree granting and the total units are greater than 6, provide the number of unique courses and the minimum total units offered.
For each department and subject code where the department is degree granting, provide the number of subject codes and the minimum department budget code.

For each department name and course level where the course is degree granting and the total units are greater than 6, provide the number of unique courses, the minimum total units offered, and the average total units for that department and course level.

sub_sqls: SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL;

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.course_count, ic.min_total_units, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.course_count, ic.min_total_units;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.subject_code_count, ic.min_dept_budget_code, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each degree-granting department with a department budget code greater than 100000, excluding the Mathematics and Physics departments, where the total clearing cost collector is greater than the average clearing cost collector across all such departments, provide the department name, the total clearing cost collector, and the department's school name. List the results ordered by department name and total clearing cost collector descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS total_clearing_cost_collector FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_clearing_cost_collector FROM inner_cte WHERE total_clearing_cost_collector > ( SELECT AVG(total_clearing_cost_collector) FROM inner_cte ) ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS total_clearing_cost_collector, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_clearing_cost_collector, ic.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte ic ) SELECT s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.total_clearing_cost_collector, s2.SCHOOL_NAME FROM Subquery2 s2 WHERE s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM Subquery1) ORDER BY s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.total_clearing_cost_collector DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS total_clearing_cost_collector FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_clearing_cost_collector FROM inner_cte WHERE total_clearing_cost_collector > ( SELECT AVG(total_clearing_cost_collector) FROM inner_cte );

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS total_clearing_cost_collector, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_clearing_cost_collector, ic.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte ic;

question: For each academic building at MIT that is owned by MIT and has a total area of rooms used for "RESIDENT" or "LABS" purposes greater than 1000, provide the building name, the fiscal period, the total area of such rooms, the running sum of assignable area within each campus sector, and the building's external gross area. Only include buildings that are not the Stata building. Order the results by fiscal period and building name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, SUM(fr.AREA) AS total_room_area, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC IN ('RESIDENT', 'LABS') AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING SUM(fr.AREA) > 1000 ), BuildingPeriods AS ( SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD, ic.total_room_area, ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM inner_cte1 ic JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ), BuildingRoomArea AS ( SELECT bp.BUILDING_NAME, bp.FISCAL_PERIOD, bp.total_room_area, bp.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM BuildingPeriods bp WHERE bp.total_room_area > 0 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD, SUM(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) OVER ( PARTITION BY fb.CAMPUS_SECTOR ORDER BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS running_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING fb JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> '32' ), BuildingAssignableArea AS ( SELECT icte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, icte.BUILDING_NAME, icte.FISCAL_PERIOD, icte.running_assignable_area, fb.EXT_GROSS_AREA FROM inner_cte2 icte JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON icte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ) SELECT bra.BUILDING_NAME, bra.FISCAL_PERIOD, bra.total_room_area, baa.running_assignable_area, baa.EXT_GROSS_AREA FROM BuildingRoomArea bra JOIN BuildingAssignableArea baa ON bra.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = baa.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND bra.FISCAL_PERIOD = baa.FISCAL_PERIOD ORDER BY bra.FISCAL_PERIOD, bra.BUILDING_NAME;

sub_sqls: SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, SUM(fr.AREA) AS total_room_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC IN ('RESIDENT', 'LABS') AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME HAVING total_room_area > 1000 ;

SELECT fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD, SUM(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY fb.CAMPUS_SECTOR ORDER BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING fb JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> '32' ORDER BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, SUM(fr.AREA) AS total_room_area, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC IN ('RESIDENT', 'LABS') AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING SUM(fr.AREA) > 1000 ), BuildingPeriods AS ( SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD, ic.total_room_area FROM inner_cte ic JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ) SELECT bp.BUILDING_NAME, bp.FISCAL_PERIOD, SUM(bp.total_room_area) AS total_room_area FROM BuildingPeriods bp GROUP BY bp.FISCAL_PERIOD, bp.BUILDING_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(bp.total_room_area) > 0 ORDER BY bp.FISCAL_PERIOD, bp.BUILDING_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD, SUM(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY fb.CAMPUS_SECTOR ORDER BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING fb JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> '32' ) SELECT icte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, icte.BUILDING_NAME, icte.FISCAL_PERIOD, icte.running_assignable_area, fb.EXT_GROSS_AREA FROM inner_cte icte JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON icte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY icte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, icte.FISCAL_PERIOD;

question: For each subject code where the department is degree granting, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, the number of subject codes per school name, whether the subject code description is present ('Has Description') or missing ('No Description'), and for subjects offered in the term with code '2022SU' that match the subject code, also show the subject's ID, total units, and their dense rank considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the total number of units. For each school name, include a grand total for all subject codes in the format of (null, null, null, school name, null, total subject codes, null, null, null). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), SubjectCodeVisibility AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, CASE WHEN SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND SUBJECT_CODE_DESC <> 'nan' THEN 'Has Description' ELSE 'No Description' END AS description_status FROM inner_cte1 ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, description_status, COUNT(*) AS total_subject_codes FROM SubjectCodeVisibility GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, description_status WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ), SubjectCodeSummary AS ( SELECT scv.SUBJECT_CODE, scv.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.description_status, rr.total_subject_codes FROM RollupResults rr LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, description_status FROM SubjectCodeVisibility ) scv ON rr.SCHOOL_NAME = scv.SCHOOL_NAME AND rr.description_status = scv.description_status ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.SUBJECT_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2022SU' ), SubjectUnitsRank AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte2.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.window_column, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 ) SELECT scs.SUBJECT_CODE, scs.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scs.SCHOOL_NAME, scs.description_status, scs.total_subject_codes, sur.SUBJECT_ID, sur.TOTAL_UNITS, sur.window_column FROM SubjectCodeSummary scs LEFT JOIN SubjectUnitsRank sur ON scs.SUBJECT_CODE = sur.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY scs.SCHOOL_NAME, scs.description_status, sur.TOTAL_UNITS DESC
sub_questions: For each subject code where the department is degree granting, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, and rank of the subject code within each school name group ordered by subject code.
For subjects offered in the term with code '2022SU', show the subject IDs and their dense rank considering the current and 2 preceding rows ordered by the total number of units.

sub_sqls: SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'

SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2022SU'

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ), SubjectCodeVisibility AS ( SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, CASE WHEN SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND SUBJECT_CODE_DESC <> 'nan' THEN 'Has Description' ELSE 'No Description' END AS description_status FROM inner_cte ), RollupResults AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, description_status, COUNT(*) AS total_subject_codes FROM SubjectCodeVisibility GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, description_status WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ) SELECT scv.SUBJECT_CODE, scv.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.description_status, rr.total_subject_codes FROM RollupResults rr LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, description_status FROM SubjectCodeVisibility ) scv ON rr.SCHOOL_NAME = scv.SCHOOL_NAME AND rr.description_status = scv.description_status ORDER BY rr.SCHOOL_NAME, rr.description_status;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY t1.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2022SU' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS DESC;

question: For each space unit, list the space unit name and the number of rooms assigned to it, but only include those space units where the number of rooms with an access level of at least 1 is greater than the average number of such rooms per space unit. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(zr.BUILDING_ROOM) AS room_count FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD zr ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE zr.ACCESS_LEVEL >= 1 GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT ) SELECT SPACE_UNIT, room_count FROM inner_cte WHERE room_count > (SELECT AVG(room_count) FROM inner_cte);
sub_questions: List the top 10 space units by the number of rooms assigned to them, showing the space unit name and the count of rooms, only including rooms with an access level of at least 1.
sub_sqls: SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(zr.BUILDING_ROOM) AS room_count FROM SPACE_UNIT su JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD zr ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE zr.ACCESS_LEVEL >= 1 GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT ORDER BY room_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each subject code in the Political Science department, what is the subject code, subject code description, the geometric mean of the number of students in each degree-granting department associated with that subject code, and the total number of students across all such departments for each subject code, along with, for each department and school associated with those subject codes, the department name, school name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are degree granting (excluding 'Mathematics' departments), and the department phone number? Present the results ordered by subject code, school name, and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH PoliticalScienceSubjectStats AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(student_count))) AS geometric_mean_students, SUM(student_count) AS total_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY GROUP BY DEPARTMENT ) m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ), DepartmentUnitsStats AS ( SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_range, icte.total_units_variance, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT <> '18' GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) icte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ps.SUBJECT_CODE, ps.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ps.geometric_mean_students, ps.total_students, du.DEPARTMENT_NAME, du.SCHOOL_NAME, du.avg_total_units, du.total_units_range, du.total_units_variance, du.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM PoliticalScienceSubjectStats ps JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON ps.SUBJECT_CODE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN DepartmentUnitsStats du ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = du.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY ps.SUBJECT_CODE, ps.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ps.geometric_mean_students, ps.total_students, du.DEPARTMENT_NAME, du.SCHOOL_NAME, du.avg_total_units, du.total_units_range, du.total_units_variance, du.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER ORDER BY ps.SUBJECT_CODE, du.SCHOOL_NAME, du.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

sub_sqls: SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(student_count))) AS geometric_mean_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY GROUP BY DEPARTMENT ) m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_students DESC;

SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT <> '18' GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(student_count))) AS geometric_mean_students, SUM(student_count) AS total_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY GROUP BY DEPARTMENT ) m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, geometric_mean_students, total_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, geometric_mean_students, total_students WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(total_students) > 0 ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT <> '18' GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_range, icte.total_units_variance, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For subjects offered in the term with code '2025FA', show the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, and the difference between the number of enrolled students for each subject and the minimum number of enrolled students in its offering department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ) SELECT SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_START_DATE, TERM_END_DATE, TERM_PARAMETER, (NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - min_enrolled_students_per_dept) AS deviation_from_min_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte ORDER BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME;
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the term with code '2025FA', show the subject ID, subject title, offering department name, number of enrolled students, term description, academic year, term start date, term end date, term parameter, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each offering department, ordered by offering department.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME

question: For each department and school in the current academic term, what is the maximum subject enrollment number and the term start date, considering only departments where the maximum subject enrollment number is greater than 5? For each school, include a grand total for all departments in the format of (null department, school, null term start date, total max enrollment). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment, at.TERM_START_DATE, ss.SCHOOL_NAME FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_START_DATE, ss.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 5 ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, TERM_START_DATE, SUM(max_enrollment) AS total_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, TERM_START_DATE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(max_enrollment) > 0 ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME
sub_questions: For each department in the current academic term, what is the maximum subject enrollment number and the term start date, considering only departments where the maximum subject enrollment number is greater than 5?
sub_sqls: SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment, at.TERM_START_DATE FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 5;

question: For the top 10 departments by number of subjects offered in the 2022 academic year (excluding the Political Science department and only including departments that grant degrees), and also excluding the Biology department, provide each department's name, the count of subjects offered, and the variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in 2022. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptUnitsVariance AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), Top10DeptSubjectCount AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT t.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.subject_count, d.total_units_variance FROM Top10DeptSubjectCount t JOIN DeptUnitsVariance d ON t.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and the variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the year 2022, but only include departments that grant degrees and exclude the Biology department (Course 7).

List the top 10 departments by the number of subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, showing each department's name and the count of subjects, but exclude the Political Science department (Course 17) from the results and only include departments that grant degrees.
sub_sqls: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each department that is degree granting and is not the Biology department, what is the department name, the variance of the number of students in each student year for that department, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of students in each student year for that department, and, for the Mathematics department and each academic year where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10, the academic year, the number of unique subjects, and the minimum total units offered? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH student_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ), DepartmentStudentStats AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(num_students) AS variance_num_students, STDDEV(num_students) AS stddev_num_students FROM student_counts GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ), MathSubjectStats AS ( SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.variance_num_students, dss.stddev_num_students, mss.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mss.num_unique_subjects, mss.min_total_units FROM DepartmentStudentStats dss LEFT JOIN MathSubjectStats mss ON dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mss.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the department name and both the variance and standard deviation of the number of students in each student year for that department, considering only departments that are degree granting and are not the Biology department?

For each department and academic year where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10 and the department is Mathematics, provide the number of unique subjects and the minimum total units offered.
sub_sqls: WITH student_counts AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(num_students) AS variance_num_students, STDDEV(num_students) AS stddev_num_students FROM student_counts GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: For each subject offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025" that also has more than 0 enrolled students and a material status key of 'U', show the subject offered key, subject title, offering department name, the term description, the rank of each subject within its offering department, the course number, course number description, number of enrolled students, the reserve catalog key, the dense rank over the material status key ordered by material status key, and the start and end dates of the term, with the columns listed in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_rank_in_dept, l.COURSE_NUMBER, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, d.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS dense_rank_material_status, s.SUBJECT_ID, t.TERM_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER p ON t.TERM_CODE = p.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l ON s.SUBJECT_ID = l.SUBJECT_ID JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL d ON l.SUBJECT_ID = d.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' AND l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) SELECT i.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.subject_rank_in_dept, i.COURSE_NUMBER, i.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, i.dense_rank_material_status, t.TERM_START_DATE, t.TERM_END_DATE FROM inner_cte i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON i.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE ORDER BY i.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, i.COURSE_NUMBER;
sub_questions: For each subject offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025", show the subject offered key, subject title, offering department name, the term description, and the rank of each subject within its offering department ordered by subject offered key.

List the course number, course number description, number of enrolled students, and the reserve catalog key for each subject, along with dense ranks over the material status key ordered by material status key, for subjects that have more than 0 enrolled students and a material status key of 'U'.

For each subject offered in the term with the description "Fall Term 2024-2025" that also has more than 0 enrolled students and a material status key of 'U', show the subject offered key, subject title, offering department name, the term description, the rank of each subject within its offering department, the course number, course number description, number of enrolled students, the reserve catalog key, and the dense rank over the material status key ordered by material status key, with the columns listed in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025'

SELECT t1.COURSE_NUMBER, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U'

WITH SubjectOfferedInTerm AS ( SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' ), LibrarySubjectWithReserve AS ( SELECT t1.COURSE_NUMBER, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS window_column, t1.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) SELECT s.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.window_column AS subject_rank_in_dept, l.COURSE_NUMBER, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, l.window_column AS dense_rank_material_status FROM SubjectOfferedInTerm s JOIN LibrarySubjectWithReserve l ON s.SUBJECT_ID = l.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, l.COURSE_NUMBER;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2017JA' by the Chemistry department (Course 5), show the subject ID, subject title, offering department code, offering department name, number of enrolled students, department full name, school name, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each department code group. Additionally, for each such subject, include the department name, the variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the year 2022 (excluding the Biology department and only including degree-granting departments), and the average number of enrolled students for subjects offered by that department in the year 2022. Order the results by department code and variance of total units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH ChemistrySubjects AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS min_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = '5' ), DepartmentUnitsVariance AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ), DepartmentEnrolledAvg AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students_2022 FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE LIKE '2022%' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT cs.SUBJECT_ID, cs.SUBJECT_TITLE, cs.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, cs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cs.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, cs.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, cs.SCHOOL_NAME, cs.min_enrolled_students, duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, duv.total_units_variance, dea.avg_enrolled_students_2022 FROM ChemistrySubjects cs JOIN DepartmentUnitsVariance duv ON cs.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = duv.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN DepartmentEnrolledAvg dea ON cs.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = dea.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY cs.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, duv.total_units_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the term '2017JA' by the Chemistry department (Course 5), show the subject ID, subject title, offering department code, offering department name, number of enrolled students, department full name, school name, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each department code group, ordered by department code, and only include subjects where the offering department name is 'Chemistry'.

For each department, give the department name and the variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the year 2022, but only include departments that grant degrees and exclude the Biology department (Course 7).

For subjects offered in the term '2017JA' by the Chemistry department (Course 5), show the subject ID, subject title, offering department code, offering department name, number of enrolled students, department full name, school name, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each department code group. Additionally, for each such subject, include the department name and the variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the year 2022, but only include departments that grant degrees and exclude the Biology department (Course 7). Order the results by department code and variance of total units in descending order.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS min_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = '5'

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

WITH ChemistrySubjects AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS min_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = '5' ), DepartmentUnitsVariance AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT cs.SUBJECT_ID, cs.SUBJECT_TITLE, cs.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, cs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cs.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, cs.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, cs.SCHOOL_NAME, cs.min_enrolled_students, duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, duv.total_units_variance FROM ChemistrySubjects cs JOIN DepartmentUnitsVariance duv ON cs.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = duv.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY cs.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, duv.total_units_variance DESC;

question: List, for each department, the department name, academic year, academic year description, number of degree-granting subjects offered in 2022 (if at least 5), average, range, and variance of total units for those subjects, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for all library reserve materials offered in terms with material status 'U', along with a reason for inclusion ('2022 Degree-Granting Subjects' for the first case and 'Library Reserve Materials' for the second). The columns should be: department name, academic year, academic year description, subject count, average total units, total units range, total units variance, coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and reason. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptStats2022 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_count, AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ), LibResMatrlStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ), CombinedStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, d.subject_count, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_range, d.total_units_variance, NULL AS coefficient_of_variation, '2022 Degree-Granting Subjects' AS Reason FROM DeptStats2022 d UNION ALL SELECT l.DEPARTMENT_NAME, l.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS subject_count, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS total_units_range, NULL AS total_units_variance, l.coefficient_of_variation, 'Library Reserve Materials' AS Reason FROM LibResMatrlStats l ) SELECT * FROM CombinedStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are degree granting.

For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the coefficient of variation of the total units for all library reserve materials offered in terms that have a material status of 'U'?

For each department, among subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are degree granting, provide the department name, the number of subjects offered, and the average, range, and variance of the total units for those subjects, but only include departments that offered at least 5 such subjects.

For each academic year, what is the academic year description, the department name, and the coefficient of variation of the total units for all library reserve materials offered in terms that have a material status of 'U'?
sub_sqls: SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_count, AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY subject_count DESC, total_units_range DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units, show the subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, term description, and the rank of each subject within its department ordered by subject code. Additionally, for each subject's department, include the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects that have at least one enrolled student and have required course materials. Display the results ordered by department name and subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 ), subq2 AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column, s2.avg_total_units, s2.total_units_range, s2.total_units_variance FROM subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE

SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

question: For each school and department combination (including a grand total per school with department as null), what is the school name, department name, the variance of the CIP program code for all degree-granting courses with non-null department name in the Mathematics department (Course 18), the geometric mean of the total units of subjects offered by departments in that school (considering only subjects with more than zero total units and that are offered this year, and only for departments that are degree-granting and not the Department of Management), the overall average geometric mean across all schools, and whether the school's geometric mean is 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' (at least 5% greater than the overall average), 'BELOW_AVERAGE' (at least 5% less than the overall average), or 'AVERAGE' otherwise? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.COURSE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), rollup_cte1 AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, cip_code_variance FROM inner_cte1 UNION ALL SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.COURSE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME ), cte1_final AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, cip_code_variance FROM rollup_cte1 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, EXP(AVG(LOG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME ), cte2_final AS ( SELECT i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.geometric_mean_total_units, s.avg_geometric_mean, CASE WHEN i.geometric_mean_total_units > s.avg_geometric_mean * 1.05 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.geometric_mean_total_units < s.avg_geometric_mean * 0.95 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS comparison_to_average FROM inner_cte2 i CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_total_units) AS avg_geometric_mean FROM inner_cte2) s ) SELECT c1.SCHOOL_NAME, c1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c1.cip_code_variance, c2.geometric_mean_total_units, c2.avg_geometric_mean, c2.comparison_to_average FROM cte1_final c1 JOIN cte2_final c2 ON c1.SCHOOL_NAME = c2.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY c1.SCHOOL_NAME, c1.DEPARTMENT_NAME

sub_sqls: SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.COURSE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY cip_code_variance DESC;

SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, EXP(AVG(LOG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME ;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.COURSE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) , rollup_cte AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, cip_code_variance FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.COURSE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, cip_code_variance FROM rollup_cte ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, EXP(AVG(LOG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.geometric_mean_total_units, s.avg_geometric_mean, CASE WHEN i.geometric_mean_total_units > s.avg_geometric_mean * 1.05 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.geometric_mean_total_units < s.avg_geometric_mean * 0.95 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS comparison_to_average FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_total_units) AS avg_geometric_mean FROM inner_cte) s ORDER BY i.SCHOOL_NAME;

question: For each academic building at MIT that is owned by MIT (excluding the Stata building), and for each fiscal period, provide the building name, the fiscal period, the total area of rooms used for "RESIDENT" or "LABS" purposes (considering only buildings with a total room area greater than 1000), the running sum of assignable area within each campus sector, and the building's external gross area. Only include buildings classified as academic buildings and owned by MIT. Order the results by fiscal period and building name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH BuildingRoomArea AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, SUM(fr.AREA) AS total_room_area, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC IN ('RESIDENT', 'LABS') AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING SUM(fr.AREA) > 1000 ), BuildingPeriods AS ( SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD, ic.total_room_area, ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM inner_cte ic JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ) SELECT bp.BUILDING_NAME, bp.FISCAL_PERIOD, SUM(bp.total_room_area) AS total_room_area, bp.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM BuildingPeriods bp GROUP BY bp.FISCAL_PERIOD, bp.BUILDING_NAME, bp.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(bp.total_room_area) > 0 ), AcademicBuildingArea AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD, SUM(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) OVER ( PARTITION BY fb.CAMPUS_SECTOR ORDER BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS running_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING fb JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> '32' ) SELECT icte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, icte.BUILDING_NAME, icte.FISCAL_PERIOD, icte.running_assignable_area, fb.EXT_GROSS_AREA FROM inner_cte icte JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON icte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ) SELECT bra.BUILDING_NAME, bra.FISCAL_PERIOD, bra.total_room_area, aba.running_assignable_area, aba.EXT_GROSS_AREA FROM BuildingRoomArea bra JOIN AcademicBuildingArea aba ON bra.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = aba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND bra.FISCAL_PERIOD = aba.FISCAL_PERIOD WHERE bra.BUILDING_NAME IS NOT NULL ORDER BY bra.FISCAL_PERIOD, bra.BUILDING_NAME;
sub_questions: For each building, give the building name and calculate the total area of rooms used for "RESIDENT" or "LABS" purposes, considering only buildings with a total room area greater than 1000, and only include buildings that are classified as "academic buildings" and are owned by MIT.

For academic buildings at MIT, show the building key, building name, fiscal period, and the running sum of assignable area within each campus sector, but only include buildings that are owned, and exclude the Stata building. Order the results by building key.

For each building, provide the building name, the fiscal period, and the total area of rooms used for "RESIDENT" or "LABS" purposes, considering only buildings with a total room area greater than 1000, and only include buildings that are classified as "academic buildings" and are owned by MIT. For each fiscal period, include a grand total for all buildings in the format of (null, fiscal period, total room area).

For academic buildings at MIT, show the building key, building name, fiscal period, and the running sum of assignable area within each campus sector, but only include buildings that are owned, and exclude the Stata building. Also, for each result, include the building's external gross area from the FCLT_BUILDING table. Order the results by building key and fiscal period.
sub_sqls: SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, SUM(fr.AREA) AS total_room_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC IN ('RESIDENT', 'LABS') AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME HAVING total_room_area > 1000 ;

SELECT fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD, SUM(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY fb.CAMPUS_SECTOR ORDER BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING fb JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> '32' ORDER BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, SUM(fr.AREA) AS total_room_area, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC IN ('RESIDENT', 'LABS') AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING SUM(fr.AREA) > 1000 ), BuildingPeriods AS ( SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD, ic.total_room_area FROM inner_cte ic JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ) SELECT bp.BUILDING_NAME, bp.FISCAL_PERIOD, SUM(bp.total_room_area) AS total_room_area FROM BuildingPeriods bp GROUP BY bp.FISCAL_PERIOD, bp.BUILDING_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(bp.total_room_area) > 0 ORDER BY bp.FISCAL_PERIOD, bp.BUILDING_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD, SUM(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY fb.CAMPUS_SECTOR ORDER BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING fb JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> '32' ) SELECT icte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, icte.BUILDING_NAME, icte.FISCAL_PERIOD, icte.running_assignable_area, fb.EXT_GROSS_AREA FROM inner_cte icte JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON icte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY icte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, icte.FISCAL_PERIOD;

question: List all departments that either (1) are the Mathematics department with a total number of enrolled students in all subjects offered by that department more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the average total enrolled students across all departments, or (2) are degree-granting departments (excluding Electrical Engineering and Computer Science) with at least 5 courses listed in the course catalog, along with the department code, department name, the total number of enrolled students (for the Mathematics department case), the total number of unique course titles (for the degree-granting case), and a reason for inclusion ("High Enrollment Mathematics" or "Degree-Granting with Many Courses"). The columns should be: department code, department name, total number of enrolled students, total number of unique course titles, and reason for inclusion, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > ( SELECT AVG(total_enrolled) + STDDEV(total_enrolled) FROM ( SELECT SUM(sos2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd2 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos2 ON sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc2 ON ssc2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) t ) ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS unique_course_titles FROM inner_cte ic JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ic.num_courses >= 5 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY unique_course_titles DESC ), CombinedDepartments AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_enrolled_students AS Metric, NULL AS unique_course_titles, 'High Enrollment Mathematics' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 UNION ALL SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS Metric, unique_course_titles, 'Degree-Granting with Many Courses' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, Metric, unique_course_titles, Reason FROM CombinedDepartments ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_CODE, Reason;

question: From the top 10 academic years with the highest standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students in library subjects offered during terms in that year (considering only years with more than 5 subjects offered, and only including subjects that are offered in the fall term and are from the Mathematics department), display each academic year's description, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students, and the subject with the highest enrollment in that year, along with its subject title and number of enrolled students. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, STDDEV(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_num_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON lso.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.stddev_num_enrolled_students, ls.SUBJECT_ID AS Top_Subject_ID, ls.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Top_Subject_Title, ls.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS Top_Enrollment FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON lso.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' ) ls ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ls.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND ls.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.stddev_num_enrolled_students DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For students whose employee type is 'Student', who are in department 6 (Electrical Engineering and Computer Science), and whose department name is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci', show their MIT ID, full name, department name, student year, the running sum of MIT IDs within each student year group ordered by MIT ID, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in regular academic terms in their department (excluding 'Mathematics'). sql: WITH student_info AS ( SELECT sp.MIT_ID, sp.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, SUM(sp.MIT_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR ORDER BY sp.MIT_ID) AS running_sum_mit_id FROM SE_PERSON sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Student' AND msd.DEPARTMENT = 6 AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR, sp.MIT_ID ), dept_units_variation AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT si.MIT_ID, si.FULL_NAME, si.DEPARTMENT_NAME, si.STUDENT_YEAR, si.running_sum_mit_id, duv.coefficient_of_variation FROM student_info si LEFT JOIN dept_units_variation duv ON si.DEPARTMENT_NAME = duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY si.STUDENT_YEAR, si.MIT_ID;

sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, sub.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(sub.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL aca ON sub.TERM_CODE = aca.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER param ON aca.TERM_CODE = param.TERM_CODE WHERE param.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND sub.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, aca.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, sub.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(sub.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(coefficient_of_variation) AS total_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(coefficient_of_variation) > 0 ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2008 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.avg_total_units, ic.total_units_range, ic.total_units_variance FROM inner_cte ic WHERE ic.avg_total_units = ( SELECT MAX(avg_total_units) FROM inner_cte ) ) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.total_coefficient_of_variation, s2.avg_total_units, s2.total_units_range, s2.total_units_variance FROM subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;
