question: For each academic year, what is the academic year, academic year description, the geometric mean of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered during that year (considering only subjects with more than zero enrolled students), the number of distinct departments that offered such subjects in that year, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of subjects offered per academic term in that year (considering only terms where at least one subject was offered), and the variability category for the year (classified as 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' if the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is at least 20% greater than the average standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all years, 'LOW_VARIABILITY' if at least 20% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise)? sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment, COUNT(DISTINCT LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS num_departments FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(term_subject_count) - MIN(term_subject_count) AS subject_count_range, VARIANCE(term_subject_count) AS subject_count_variance, STDDEV(term_subject_count) AS subject_count_stddev FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN ( SELECT tso.TERM_CODE, COUNT(*) AS term_subject_count FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso GROUP BY tso.TERM_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ) tsc ON at.TERM_CODE = tsc.TERM_CODE GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.subject_count_range, ic.subject_count_variance, ic.subject_count_stddev, CASE WHEN ic.subject_count_stddev > avg_stats.avg_stddev * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN ic.subject_count_stddev < avg_stats.avg_stddev * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(subject_count_stddev) AS avg_stddev FROM inner_cte ) avg_stats ) SELECT subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, subq1.geometric_mean_enrollment, subq1.num_departments, subq2.subject_count_range, subq2.subject_count_variance, subq2.subject_count_stddev, subq2.variability_category FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = subq2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY subq1.geometric_mean_enrollment DESC;

question: For the administrative department whose name is 'Mechanical Engineering' (Course 2) in the academic year 2024, and for each department that is not 'Mathematics' (Course 18) and offers subjects in regular academic terms, give the administrative department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that administrative department in 2024, the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department in regular academic terms, and the number of subjects offered by that department in regular academic terms. sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.coefficient_of_variation AS admin_dept_coefficient_of_variation, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.coefficient_of_variation AS dept_coefficient_of_variation, d.subject_count FROM inner_cte icte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) d;

WITH AdminDeptCov AS ( SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), DeptCov AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT adc.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, adc.coefficient_of_variation AS admin_dept_coefficient_of_variation, dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dc.coefficient_of_variation AS dept_coefficient_of_variation FROM AdminDeptCov adc CROSS JOIN DeptCov dc;

question: For each school and department, list the school name, department name, average total units, range of total units, and variance of total units for degree-granting subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, excluding the Mathematics department (Course 18), and include a grand total for all departments in each school (with department name as null). Also, for each department in the School of Engineering (excluding Management) that grants degrees and has a total student enrollment in its offered courses greater than 50, list the department name, total enrollment, the most popular course by enrollment, and its enrollment count. For each result, indicate the reason for inclusion as either 'UnitsStats' or 'EnrollmentStats'. The columns should be: school name, department name, average total units, total units range, total units variance, total enrollment, most popular course, course enrollment, and reason. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.SCHOOL_NAME, SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT <> '18' ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT WITH ROLLUP HAVING SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.total_enrollment, t.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Most_Popular_Course, t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS Course_Enrollment FROM inner_cte ic JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = ( SELECT MAX(t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 WHERE t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.avg_total_units, s1.total_units_range, s1.total_units_variance, NULL AS total_enrollment, NULL AS Most_Popular_Course, NULL AS Course_Enrollment, 'UnitsStats' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT 'Engineering' AS SCHOOL_NAME, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS total_units_range, NULL AS total_units_variance, s2.total_enrollment, s2.Most_Popular_Course, s2.Course_Enrollment, 'EnrollmentStats' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 s2 ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, total_units_range, total_units_variance, total_enrollment, Most_Popular_Course, Course_Enrollment, Reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are degree granting, but only include departments that are not 'Mathematics' (Course 18).

For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of students enrolled in courses offered by that department in the School of Engineering, where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 50, and restrict the results to departments that grant degrees and exclude the Department of Management (Course 15).

For each school, list the school name, the department name, and calculate the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are degree granting, but only include departments that are not 'Mathematics' (Course 18). For each school, also include a grand total for all departments in that school in the format of (school name, null, aggregated values).

Among departments in the School of Engineering that grant degrees (excluding the Department of Management), which departments have a total student enrollment in their offered courses greater than 50, and for each such department, what is the most popular course (by enrollment) they offer and its enrollment count?
sub_sqls: SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT <> '18' GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC;

SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.SCHOOL_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT <> '18' ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrollment, t.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Most_Popular_Course, t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS Course_Enrollment FROM inner_cte ic JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = ( SELECT MAX(t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 WHERE t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) ORDER BY ic.total_enrollment DESC;

question: For each department, provide the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one associated course material. Additionally, for subjects in the "Engineering" school with total units equal to 1 in that department, show the subject ID, subject title, department name, academic year, the rank of each subject within its academic year group ordered by subject ID, and the term description for each subject. Present the results ordered by the enrollment standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) in descending order, then by academic year and subject rank. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC ) SELECT des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_stddev, es.SUBJECT_ID, es.SUBJECT_TITLE, es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.ACADEMIC_YEAR, es.window_column, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte des JOIN ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 ) es ON des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = es.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ata ON es.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE ORDER BY des.enrollment_stddev DESC, es.ACADEMIC_YEAR, es.window_column;
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and find the average and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one associated course material.

For subjects in the "Engineering" school with total units equal to 1, show the subject ID, subject title, department name, academic year, and the rank of each subject within its academic year group ordered by subject ID.

For each department, give the department name, the average and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in courses that have at least one associated course material, and for subjects in the "Engineering" school with total units equal to 1 in that department, show the subject ID, subject title, department name, academic year, and the rank of each subject within its academic year group ordered by subject ID. Present the results ordered by the enrollment standard deviation in descending order, then by academic year and subject rank.
sub_sqls: SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC;

SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1

WITH DeptEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_stddev DESC ), EngineeringSubjects AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 ) SELECT des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, des.avg_enrollment, des.enrollment_stddev, es.SUBJECT_ID, es.SUBJECT_TITLE, es.DEPARTMENT_NAME, es.ACADEMIC_YEAR, es.window_column FROM DeptEnrollmentStats des JOIN EngineeringSubjects es ON des.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = es.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY des.enrollment_stddev DESC, es.ACADEMIC_YEAR, es.window_column;

question: For each department in the School of Engineering where the total number of students enrolled in courses offered by that department is greater than the average total enrollment across all Engineering departments (and the total enrollment is greater than 50), show the department name and total enrollment, and for each such department, show the library reserve material details with material status key equal to 'U', including the library course instructor key, library reserve catalog key, term code, subject ID, the tip material key, tip material status key, tip ISBN, the subject title, the minimum tip material status key in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the number of enrolled students, as well as the responsible faculty name and the offer department name, for materials offered by that department. The columns should be: department name, total enrollment, library course instructor key, library reserve catalog key, term code, subject ID, tip material key, tip material status key, tip ISBN, subject title, windowed minimum tip material status key, responsible faculty name, and offer department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH engineering_dept_enrollment AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_enrollment FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT AVG(total_enrollment) AS avg_enrollment FROM ( SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50 ) sub ) a ON i.total_enrollment > a.avg_enrollment ), library_reserve_materials AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT l.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, l.TERM_CODE, l.SUBJECT_ID, t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t.ISBN, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MIN(t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) OVER ( ORDER BY s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column, s.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' ) SELECT inner_cte.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, inner_cte.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, inner_cte.ISBN, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.window_column, s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON inner_cte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = s.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ) SELECT ede.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ede.total_enrollment, lrm.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, lrm.TERM_CODE, lrm.SUBJECT_ID, lrm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, lrm.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, lrm.ISBN, lrm.SUBJECT_TITLE, lrm.window_column, lrm.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, lrm.OFFER_DEPT_NAME FROM engineering_dept_enrollment ede JOIN library_reserve_materials lrm ON ede.DEPARTMENT_NAME = lrm.OFFER_DEPT_NAME

question: For each subject offered in the library, show the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, term description, academic year, subject short title, and the maximum total units for each row and the next two rows in order of subject ID, considering only subjects offered in the 'Mathematics' department during regular terms, along with the average, range, and variance of CIP program codes for all courses offered by that department where the department is degree granting and the course level is undergraduate. Present the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, term description, academic year, subject short title, maximum total units, average CIP program code, CIP program code range, and CIP program code variance in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH Sub1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, MAX(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS JOIN_DEPT_NAME FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ), Sub2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_code, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cip_code_range DESC ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, s1.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, s2.avg_cip_code, s2.cip_code_range, s2.cip_code_variance FROM Sub1 s1 LEFT JOIN Sub2 s2 ON s1.JOIN_DEPT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME
sub_questions: For each subject offered in the library, show the subject title, number of enrolled students, offering department name, term description, academic year, subject short title, and the maximum total units for each row and the next two rows in order of subject ID, considering only subjects offered in the 'Mathematics' department during regular terms.

For each department, give the department name and calculate the average, range, and variance of CIP program codes for all courses offered by that department where the department is degree granting and the course level is undergraduate.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, MAX(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y'

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_code, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cip_code_range DESC;

question: For each department and subject grade type where the subject is offered in the current academic year, is letter graded, and the department is Mathematics (Course 18), provide the department name, grade type, the number of such subjects, the minimum total units, and, if the department is among the top 10 departments by number of subjects offered in the 2022 academic year (excluding Political Science and only including degree-granting departments), also provide the number of subjects offered by that department in 2022. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH MathLetterGradedStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE, COUNT(c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE ), TopDepartments2022 AS ( SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.GRADE_TYPE, m.subject_count AS math_letter_subject_count, m.min_total_units, t.subject_count AS top_dept_2022_subject_count FROM MathLetterGradedStats m LEFT JOIN TopDepartments2022 t ON m.DEPARTMENT_NAME = t.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.GRADE_TYPE;
sub_questions: For each department and subject grade type where the subject is offered in the current academic year, is letter graded, and the department is Mathematics (Course 18), provide the number of subjects and the minimum total units.

List the top 10 departments by the number of subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, showing each department's name and the count of subjects, but exclude the Political Science department (Course 17) from the results and only include departments that grant degrees.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE, COUNT(c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE;

SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each subject in the term "2010FA", show the subject ID, the term description from ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL, the material status key from TIP_DETAIL, the academic year from ACADEMIC_TERMS, and the department name from SIS_DEPARTMENT. Also, show the rank of each subject within each academic year group ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA' ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ic.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID AND ic.TERM_CODE = cso.TERM_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
sub_questions: For each subject in the term "2010FA", show the subject ID, the term description from ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL, the material status key from TIP_DETAIL, the academic year from ACADEMIC_TERMS, and the rank of each subject within each academic year group ordered by subject ID.
sub_sqls: SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA'

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2022 that are printed in the bulletin and belong to the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject title, department name, total units, and the difference between the total units of each subject and the average total units for Mathematics subjects in 2022. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.IS_PRINTED_IN_BULLETIN = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) , avg_units AS ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.TOTAL_UNITS, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - a.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg_units FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN avg_units a;
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the academic year 2022 that are printed in the bulletin and belong to the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject title, department name, total units, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title.
sub_sqls: SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS row_num_window FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.IS_PRINTED_IN_BULLETIN = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each subject offered in the Mathematics department (Course 18) that has more than 0 enrolled students and is in a degree-granting department, list the department name, subject title, number of enrolled students, and school name, along with a dense rank over the department code ordered by department code, but only include those subjects where the number of enrolled students is greater than the average number of enrolled students for all subjects in the Mathematics department. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t2 ON t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, SCHOOL_NAME, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > ( SELECT AVG(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' )
sub_questions: List the department name, subject title, number of enrolled students, and school name for each subject offered, along with dense ranks over the department code ordered by department code, for subjects with more than 0 enrolled students in departments that grant degrees, specifically for the Mathematics department (Course 18).
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t2 ON t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'

question: For each department in the Harvard Cross-Enrollment Program in 2012, what is the average total number of units for subjects with a cluster type of "SWE: School-Wide Electives", and how does each department's average compare to the overall average? Classify each department as 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' if its average is at least 10% higher than the overall average, 'BELOW_AVERAGE' if at least 10% lower, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON so.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = sos.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE so.TERM_CODE LIKE '2012%' AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND sos.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC = 'SWE: School-Wide Electives' ) , dept_avg AS ( SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ) , overall_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS overall_avg_units FROM inner_cte ) SELECT d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, d.avg_units, o.overall_avg_units, CASE WHEN d.avg_units > o.overall_avg_units * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN d.avg_units < o.overall_avg_units * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS department_performance FROM dept_avg d CROSS JOIN overall_avg o;
sub_questions: How many subjects offered in 2012 as part of the Harvard Cross-Enrollment Program, in the Chemistry department, had a cluster type of "SWE: School-Wide Electives" and a total number of units greater than 6?
sub_sqls: SELECT COUNT(*) AS swe_electives_over_6_units FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON so.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = sos.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE so.TERM_CODE LIKE '2012%' AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND sos.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC = 'SWE: School-Wide Electives' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry';

question: For each department and academic year, show the department name, academic year, academic year description, and the geometric mean of the total units for all subjects offered by the department in regular terms with total units greater than zero, along with, for each academic building where these subjects are held and which has rooms larger than 40 square meters, the building name, the average, range, and variance of the room areas, as well as the total assignable area of the building and the year the building was built. The results are ordered by department name, academic year (descending), and room area range (descending). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH dept_units AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), building_stats AS ( SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_room_area, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS room_area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS room_area_variance FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME ) SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ds.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ds.geometric_mean_total_units, bs.BUILDING_NAME, bs.avg_room_area, bs.room_area_range, bs.room_area_variance, fb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, fb.DATE_BUILT FROM dept_units ds JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ds.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN FCLT_ROOMS fr ON cso.MEET_PLACE = fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN building_stats bs ON fb.BUILDING_NAME = bs.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC, bs.room_area_range DESC;
sub_questions: For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the geometric mean of the total units for all subjects offered in terms that are regular terms and have total units greater than zero?

For each building, give the building name and calculate the average, range, and variance of the room areas for rooms in that building where the building type is 'ACADEMIC' and the room area is greater than 40.

Show the department names, academic year, academic year description, and the geometric mean of the total units for all subjects offered by each department in regular terms with total units greater than zero.

For each academic building with rooms larger than 40 square meters, show the building name, the average, range, and variance of the room areas, and also display the total assignable area of the building and the year the building was built.
sub_sqls: SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_total_units DESC;

SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_room_area, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS room_area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS room_area_variance FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY room_area_range DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_room_area, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS room_area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS room_area_variance FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND r.AREA > 40 GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME ) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.avg_room_area, ic.room_area_range, ic.room_area_variance, fb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, fb.DATE_BUILT FROM inner_cte ic JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON ic.BUILDING_NAME = fb.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY ic.room_area_range DESC;

question: For each department, provide the department's full name and calculate the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2024, but only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Biology department (Course 7). Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0

question: For each department, list the department name and the number of degree-granting subjects it offered in the term '2014FA' that had more than 5 students enrolled. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS econ_subjects_with_5plus_students, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, econ_subjects_with_5plus_students FROM inner_cte;
sub_questions: Count how many subjects offered in the term '2014FA' by the Department of Economics (Course 14) that are degree-granting had more than 5 students enrolled.
sub_sqls: SELECT COUNT(*) AS econ_subjects_with_5plus_students FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Economics' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Economics'

question: For each organization, show the organization name, the number of associated space units, and the average space unit key value for that organization. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fok JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fok.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME ) SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.space_unit_count, AVG(su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS avg_space_unit_key FROM inner_cte ic JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME = fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY GROUP BY ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.space_unit_count;
sub_questions: List the top 10 organizations by the number of associated space units, showing the organization name and the count of space units for each.
sub_sqls: SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY fok JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION fo ON fok.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY space_unit_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For each department and academic year where the number of enrolled students in the library subject offered is greater than 3, provide the department name, academic year, number of unique subjects offered, minimum start date of the term, and for each subject offered in the term '2017JA' in that department, show the subject title, number of enrolled students, responsible faculty name, offering department name, department full name, school name, and the minimum number of enrolled students in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the department code. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH DeptYearStats AS ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT so.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(at.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON at.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), TipSubjects2017JA AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' ) SELECT d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, d.ACADEMIC_YEAR, d.subject_count, d.min_term_start_date, t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS TIP_OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t.SCHOOL_NAME, t.window_column FROM DeptYearStats d JOIN TipSubjects2017JA t ON d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = t.join_dept_name
sub_questions: For each department and academic year where the number of enrolled students in the library subject offered is greater than 3, provide the number of unique subjects offered and the minimum start date of the term.

For subjects offered in the term '2017JA', show the subject title, the number of enrolled students, the responsible faculty name, the offering department name, the department full name, the school name, and the minimum number of enrolled students in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the department code.
sub_sqls: SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT so.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(at.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON at.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA'

question: For subjects offered in the term '2017JA' by the Chemistry department (Course 5), show the subject ID, subject title, offering department code, offering department name, number of enrolled students, department full name, school name, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each department code group. Additionally, for each such subject, include the department name and the variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the year 2022, but only include departments that grant degrees and exclude the Biology department (Course 7). Order the results by department code and variance of total units in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH ChemistrySubjects AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS min_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = '5' ), DepartmentUnitsVariance AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT cs.SUBJECT_ID, cs.SUBJECT_TITLE, cs.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, cs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cs.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, cs.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, cs.SCHOOL_NAME, cs.min_enrolled_students, duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, duv.total_units_variance FROM ChemistrySubjects cs JOIN DepartmentUnitsVariance duv ON cs.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = duv.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY cs.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, duv.total_units_variance DESC;
sub_questions: For subjects offered in the term '2017JA' by the Chemistry department (Course 5), show the subject ID, subject title, offering department code, offering department name, number of enrolled students, department full name, school name, and the minimum number of enrolled students over each department code group, ordered by department code, and only include subjects where the offering department name is 'Chemistry'.

For each department, give the department name and the variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the year 2022, but only include departments that grant degrees and exclude the Biology department (Course 7).
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, min(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS min_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = '5'

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC;

question: For departments where the average number of enrolled students per subject in the 2022FA term is greater than the overall average enrolled students per subject for that term (excluding the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department and only including departments that grant degrees), list the department name and the average enrolled students per subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrolled FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_enrolled > ( SELECT AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' ) ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;
domain_knowledge: "Electrical Engineering and Computer Science" is predicated by "TABLE.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '6'"
sub_questions: For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation of the total units for reserved library materials, considering only terms that are regular terms and only for the Mathematics department (Course 18).

For each department, provide the department name and the range, variance, and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department in the 2022FA term, but only include departments that grant degrees and exclude the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department (Course 6).

List, for each department, the department name, the coefficient of variation of the total units for reserved library materials (for regular terms and only for the Mathematics department), the range, variance, and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department in the 2022FA term (only for departments that grant degrees and excluding the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department), and the reason for inclusion ('LibraryMathematics' for the library materials statistics and 'DepartmentEnrollmentStats' for the enrollment statistics). The columns should be shown in the following order: department name, coefficient of variation, enrolled range, enrolled variance, enrolled standard deviation, and reason for inclusion.
sub_sqls: SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

WITH LibraryMathematics AS ( SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS)/NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC ), DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(tso.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), CombinedDepartmentStats AS ( SELECT lm.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lm.coefficient_of_variation, NULL AS enrolled_range, NULL AS enrolled_variance, NULL AS enrolled_stddev, 'LibraryMathematics' AS Reason FROM LibraryMathematics lm UNION ALL SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS coefficient_of_variation, des.enrolled_range, des.enrolled_variance, des.enrolled_stddev, 'DepartmentEnrollmentStats' AS Reason FROM DepartmentEnrollmentStats des ) SELECT * FROM CombinedDepartmentStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For academic term parameters where the term indicator is 'C', show the term parameter, the term code, the academic year, the department name of the offered subject, the running sum of academic years within each department, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and at least 1 enrolled student), and classify the department as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' if its standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is at least 20% greater than the average, 'LOW_VARIANCE' if its standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is at least 20% less than the average, or 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' otherwise. Only include departments that offer at least 3 subjects in those terms. Order the results by department name and academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_PARAMETER, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_INDICATOR = 'C' ), DeptCounts AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE IN ( SELECT TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER WHERE TERM_INDICATOR = 'C' ) GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ), cte1_result AS ( SELECT icte.TERM_PARAMETER, icte.TERM_CODE, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.window_column FROM inner_cte1 icte JOIN DeptCounts dc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), cte2_result AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.avg_total_units, inner_cte2.stddev_total_units, CASE WHEN inner_cte2.stddev_total_units > inner_cte2.avg_total_units * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte2.stddev_total_units < inner_cte2.avg_total_units * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte2 ) SELECT c1.TERM_PARAMETER, c1.TERM_CODE, c1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c1.window_column, c2.avg_total_units, c2.stddev_total_units, c2.variance_category FROM cte1_result c1 JOIN cte2_result c2 ON c1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY c1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c1.ACADEMIC_YEAR;
sub_questions: For academic term parameters where the term indicator is 'C', show the term parameter, the term code, the academic year, the department name of the offered subject, and the running sum of academic years within each department, ordered by academic year.

For each department, provide the department name and calculate the average and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and at least 1 enrolled student.

For academic term parameters where the term indicator is 'C', show the term parameter, the term code, the academic year, the department name of the offered subject, and the running sum of academic years within each department, but only include departments that offer at least 3 subjects in those terms. Order the results by department name and academic year.

For each department, provide the department name, the average and standard deviation of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and at least 1 enrolled student), and classify the department as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' if its standard deviation is at least 20% greater than the average, 'LOW_VARIANCE' if its standard deviation is at least 20% less than the average, or 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' otherwise.
sub_sqls: SELECT t0.TERM_PARAMETER, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_INDICATOR = 'C'

SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.TERM_PARAMETER, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_INDICATOR = 'C' ), DeptCounts AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE IN ( SELECT TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER WHERE TERM_INDICATOR = 'C' ) GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ) SELECT icte.TERM_PARAMETER, icte.TERM_CODE, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.window_column FROM inner_cte icte JOIN DeptCounts dc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, CASE WHEN inner_cte.stddev_total_units > inner_cte.avg_total_units * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte.stddev_total_units < inner_cte.avg_total_units * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.stddev_total_units DESC;

question: For the top 10 subject titles by the number of reserved library materials for subjects offered in the term '2009SP', what are the subject title, the offering department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only departments that grant degrees and subjects with a non-null subject code description), the count of reserved materials, and the total number of units for each subject? Please provide the subject title, the offering department name, the variance, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), the count of reserved materials, and the total units, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ), TopReservedSubjects AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT trs.SUBJECT_TITLE, trs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, des.enrolled_students_variance, des.enrolled_students_stddev, trs.reserved_materials, soss.TOTAL_UNITS FROM TopReservedSubjects trs JOIN DepartmentEnrollmentStats des ON trs.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = des.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY soss ON trs.SUBJECT_TITLE = soss.SUBJECT_TITLE AND trs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = soss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY trs.reserved_materials DESC ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte;
sub_questions: For each department, what is the variance and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that grant degrees and subjects with a non-null subject code description? Please provide the department name, the variance, and the standard deviation.

List the top 10 subject titles by the number of reserved library materials, including the subject title, the offering department name, and the count of reserved materials, for subjects offered in the term '2009SP'.

For the top 10 subject titles by the number of reserved library materials for subjects offered in the term '2009SP', what are the subject title, the offering department name, the variance and standard deviation of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only departments that grant degrees and subjects with a non-null subject code description), and the count of reserved materials? Please provide the subject title, the offering department name, the variance, the standard deviation, and the count of reserved materials, in that order.
sub_sqls: SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC;

SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, VARIANCE(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC ), TopReservedSubjects AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT trs.SUBJECT_TITLE, trs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, des.enrolled_students_variance, des.enrolled_students_stddev, trs.reserved_materials FROM TopReservedSubjects trs JOIN DepartmentEnrollmentStats des ON trs.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = des.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY trs.reserved_materials DESC;

question: For each academic year, what is the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects in the Mathematics department that had at least one required or optional material, including the academic year description? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IN ('RQ', 'EO') AND c.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC;

question: For each department name and course level where the course is degree granting and the total units are greater than 6, and for each academic year and subject in that department, provide the department name, course level, number of unique courses, minimum total units offered, number of courses where the design units are at least 3, academic year, academic year description, subject ID, total units for the subject, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms in that department and year, and the deviation of each subject's total units from the department's average in that year. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.course_count, ic.min_total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ccc.DESIGN_UNITS >= 3 THEN scd.COURSE END) AS courses_with_design_units_3_or_more FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.COURSE_LEVEL = scd.COURSE_LEVEL JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.course_count, ic.min_total_units ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ), dept_stats AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.TOTAL_UNITS, d.avg_total_units, d.stddev_total_units, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - d.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_stats d ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AND i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, deviation_from_avg DESC ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.COURSE_LEVEL, s1.course_count, s1.min_total_units, s1.courses_with_design_units_3_or_more, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.avg_total_units, s2.stddev_total_units, s2.deviation_from_avg FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.COURSE_LEVEL, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each academic building (excluding "Ashdown House"), what is the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the area of its rooms, along with the building's full name and postal code, and only include those buildings where the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is greater than the average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all academic buildings? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, a.POSTAL_CODE, STDDEV(r.AREA)/NULLIF(AVG(r.AREA),0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM FCLT_ROOMS r JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS a ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.BUILDING_NAME <> 'ASHDOWN HOUSE' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, a.POSTAL_CODE HAVING AVG(r.AREA) > 0 ) SELECT BUILDING_NAME_LONG, POSTAL_CODE, coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte WHERE coefficient_of_variation > ( SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) FROM inner_cte ) ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC;

question: For each department, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that grant degrees, students in their fourth year, and restricting to the Mathematics department? sql: SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, STDDEV(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = '4' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC;

question: For each student whose department is degree-granting and whose student year is 'G', show their full name, email address, department full name, and the difference between the length of their full name and the average length of full names for all such students. For each such student, also show, for each school in which their department offers subjects with at least one required material, the school name, the minimum number of enrolled students in those library subject offerings, and the total number of units for those subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.FULL_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' ) SELECT i.FULL_NAME, i.EMAIL_ADDRESS, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, (LENGTH(i.FULL_NAME) - avg_len.avg_full_name_length) AS diff_from_avg_length FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT AVG(LENGTH(FULL_NAME)) AS avg_full_name_length FROM inner_cte ) avg_len ON 1=1 ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' ) SELECT OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_CODE, MIN(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students, SUM(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_CODE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(TOTAL_UNITS) > 0 ) SELECT s1.FULL_NAME, s1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.diff_from_avg_length, s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s2.min_enrolled_students, s2.total_units FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY s1.FULL_NAME, s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME

question: What is the minimum CIP program code and the total number of departments for courses in the School of Engineering, considering only degree-granting departments, including the corresponding administrative department names, and specifically for the Mechanical Engineering department? sql: SELECT MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_program_code, COUNT(DISTINCT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS total_departments, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND (UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' OR scd.DEPARTMENT = '2') GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ;

question: For each department hierarchy level 2 name and organization name where the organization is assignable and the organization is not 'ADMISSIONS', and excluding organizations with ORGANIZATION_ID '138' and '250', give the number of organizations and the minimum organization number. sql: SELECT m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY m JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND f.ORGANIZATION_NAME != 'ADMISSIONS' AND f.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME;

question: For each academic year, give the academic year, the academic year description, the average of the total units, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units, and the variance of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms by the Mathematics department, where the variance is calculated only for regular terms with a term status of 'Previous'. Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH AvgStddevUnits AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC ), VarianceUnits AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC ) SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, a.avg_total_units, a.stddev_total_units, v.total_units_variance FROM AvgStddevUnits a JOIN VarianceUnits v ON a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = v.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = v.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY a.stddev_total_units DESC;
